invalidPort: The port must be an integer between 1 and 65535.
invalidHost: Enter a hostname or IP address without a scheme, path, username, or password.
passwordRequired: Re-enter the password or authorization code. Leaving it blank will not replace saved credentials.
accountsDescription: View email accounts and edit their names, colors, and connections.
startWithAccount: Start by adding an email account
accountStorageHint: Connect your mailbox, then give it a name. Settings stay on this device; passwords are kept in the system credential store.
changedIdentityHint: The server or login identity changed. MailX will not connect with old credentials until you re-enter the password.
retryAfterConnectionChange: Will retry after the connection is updated.
connectionDescription: Servers, credentials, and network routing. MailX reconnects immediately after changes.
profileDescription: Changes to the name, sender name, and color save automatically without reconnecting.
sharedPassword: Use the same password for incoming and outgoing mail
separatePasswords: Use separate incoming and outgoing passwords
storedInCredentialStore: Saved in the system credential store
addAccountDescription: Choose how to add your account, connect your mailbox, then give it a name.
manualSetup: Manual setup · Password or authorization code
serverParametersHint: Enter the incoming and outgoing server settings from your provider. Next, name this mailbox.
nameMailboxDescription: The name and color help you identify this mailbox in MailX. The optional sender name is shown to recipients. You can change these later. MailX will then sign in to sync folders.
editConnectionDescription: Edit mailbox servers, credentials, and network routing.
reconnectDescription: MailX will disconnect, sign in with the new settings, and sync. Queued messages will use the new settings on their next attempt.
incomingParametersHint: Enter the IMAP settings from your provider.
separateServersHint: Incoming and outgoing servers and usernames may differ.
useNewCredentials: This save will use the newly entered credentials.
keepSavedCredentials: Keep using saved credentials. Passwords are not displayed.
enterPassword: Enter password or email authorization code
credentialsNotDisplayed: Credentials will not appear in account details.
confirmChangedCredentials: The server or login identity changed. Re-enter passwords for affected incoming, outgoing, or proxy settings to confirm their new scope.
passwordsCleared: Entered passwords were cleared. Re-enter them if needed.
emailAddressDescription: The address used to send and receive email.
authenticationDescription: Passwords, authorization codes, and app passwords are kept securely in the system credential store.
authenticationChanged: Authentication changed. Re-enter credentials to confirm their scope for incoming and outgoing servers.
routeDescription: Choose how this account connects. Saving settings does not test the proxy.
appDefaultHint: The app default is currently a direct connection.
directConnectionHint: This account uses a direct connection.
proxyNoFallbackHint: If the proxy fails, MailX will not connect directly. The proxy resolves the destination hostname.
proxyAuthenticationHint: Enter only if required by your proxy service.
proxyHttpsImages: Load HTTPS images through this proxy
proxyHttpsImagesHint: The proxy resolves and connects to image servers; the app cannot independently verify the final IP. Re-enable this after changing the proxy address or identity.
discardChangesHint: Changes to this form and any entered passwords will be cleared.
accountNameHint: Only used for display in MailX.
senderNameHint: Shown in the From field of outgoing mail. Leave blank to show only the email address.
identificationColorHint: Helps distinguish mailboxes in the sidebar and account list.
useProviderIconHint: Turn off to use the account’s initial and identification color.
usernameDefaultHint: Leave blank to use your email address.
genericProviderDescription: Set up another email provider manually
noProvidersFound: No matching providers. Try another search.
qqSetupDescription: Enable IMAP/SMTP on the QQ Mail website, then sign in with an authorization code. Server settings are filled in for you.
qqEmailHint: Supports numeric and English @qq.com addresses, plus @vip.qq.com and @foxmail.com addresses.
qqEmailRequired: Enter a full @qq.com, @vip.qq.com or @foxmail.com address. For another provider, choose manual setup.
providerEmailRequired: Enter a full {{domains}} address. For another mailbox, choose its provider or manual setup.
neteaseSetupDescription: Enable IMAP/SMTP on the NetEase Mail website, then sign in with a client authorization code. Server settings are filled in for you.
neteaseEmailHint: Enter a full @{{domain}} free mailbox address. For another NetEase mailbox, choose its entry or manual setup.
neteaseAuthorizationCodeHint: Use the 16-character alphanumeric client authorization code generated by NetEase Mail, rather than your mailbox password. It is shown only once; create a new one if you forget it.
neteaseRangeHint: Missing older mail? Check the retrieval range on the NetEase Mail website. MailX can only sync mail the server makes available to clients.
neteaseAuthenticationHelp: Check that IMAP/SMTP is enabled and use your full email address with a valid client authorization code. Codes cannot be recovered; create a new one on the website if yours was forgotten or revoked. Also check the website for security verification prompts.
neteaseProviderPolicyHelp: Check security notices and client protocol settings on the NetEase website, then follow the official guidance before trying again manually. If the connection still fails, report a client compatibility issue.
qqAuthorizationCodeHint: Use the 16-character code generated by QQ Mail, rather than your QQ sign-in password.
qqRangeHint: Missing older mail? Check the retrieval range on the QQ Mail website. MailX can only sync mail the server makes available to clients.
getAuthorizationCode: How to get an authorization code
helpOpenFailed: Could not open the help page. Please try again.
qqAuthenticationHelp: Check that IMAP/SMTP is enabled and use a valid authorization code with your full email address. Replace the code if it was revoked or reset, or if your QQ password changed. Also check the website for security verification prompts.
verificationHint: Checks saved connections and sign-in without sending mail.
draftVerificationHint: Tests the incoming and outgoing sign-in details entered here without saving an account or sending mail. You can also skip the test and continue.
verificationSucceeded: Sign-in verified. Actual delivery has not been tested.
verificationAuthUnavailable: The server does not support the available authentication methods.
verificationConfiguration: Connection settings are unavailable. Edit the connection and try again.
verificationSecretStore: The system credential store is unavailable. Unlock it and try again.
verificationStale: Settings changed. Verify the current connection again.
removeAccountDescription: Remove this device’s account configuration, credentials and local mail records. Messages on the server will stay, and you can add the account again to sync them.
removeAccountComposerHint: This account’s compose windows will close. Unsaved content, all local drafts and send records will be removed.
removeAccountDeliveryHint: Submitted messages, including those with uncertain results, may already have arrived. Removing the account does not recall them.
removeAccountUnknown: Delivery is uncertain for {{unknown}} messages; they may already have arrived. Removing the account clears these local records.
removeAccountSending: A message is being sent. Wait for it to finish before removing this account.
removeAccountConflict: The account connection changed. Reload it before confirming removal.
credentialCleanupPending: The account was removed locally. Some credentials could not be cleared yet; the app will retry when the credential store is available.
